name: SpatialSet
signature: public sealed class SpatialSet<T> where T : unmanaged

docs.summary: Items of a host's kind found by where they are, as lights are: fog volumes, post volumes, water bodies. Shaders walk the ones holding a point with Graphite_BeginItems(Index, Stride, worldPos) and Graphite_NextItem, reading each record's data with Graphite_SpatialVec4(array, index * Stride + 1 + i). T must be a whole number of 16 byte words, laid out as the shader reads it. Static items join regions rebuilt only when one changes, moving ones a tree per view. Host thread.
The set's index, which shaders query it by.
16 byte words per record as shaders read them, the centre and radius first.
